title: canair profile.yaml
description: Profile-wide settings of a canair vehicle profile. Editor-facing: `canair validate` is the authoritative check, and like it this schema tolerates unknown top-level keys.

extends.description: Makes this bundle a capture layer over the named profile (`canair profile overlay`).

aliases.description: Former profile names that still resolve to this profile.

variant.description: The variant an old name implies (an ID from variants.yaml).

response_timeout_ms.description: ELM327 response timeout in ms, applied as ATSTxx.

multi_did_batching.description: Whether UDS service-22 multi-DID batching may be attempted.

multi_did_max.description: Max DIDs per multi-DID request (default 3; an ECU may override).

mode.description: How diagnostic arbitration IDs are formed (default normal_11bit).

rx_offset.description: 11-bit response offset: rx = tx_id + rx_offset (default 0x08; may be negative).

target_address.description: Profile-default ISO-TP target address byte (extended modes).

source_address.description: Profile-default ISO-TP source address byte (extended modes).

isotp.description: Client-side ISO-TP tuning for the slcan-tcp transport.

tx_padding.description: Fill byte canair pads its requests with (default 0xAA).

rx_padding.description: Fill byte the ECUs pad replies with (default: tx_padding).

blocksize.description: Flow-control BlockSize (0 = send all consecutive frames).

rx_flowcontrol_timeout.description: ms to wait for a flow-control frame.

rx_consecutive_frame_timeout.description: ms to wait for the next consecutive frame.

tx_data_length.description: Frame data length (8 classic; up to 64 on CAN-FD).

quirks.description: Make-specific behaviour this profile opts into.

unit_guess_candidates.description: Make-specific scalings for the slope-to-unit sniffer.
